```{r}
# Select and align columns

  select(siteId, watershed, lon, lat, geom)

seSites <- seSites |>
  select(siteId, watershed, lon, lat, geom)

mwSites <- mwSites |>
  select(siteId, watershed, lon, lat, geom)

# Combine all into one

allSites <- allSites |>
  filter(
    siteId %in%
      c(
        "SFM01",
        "SHM01",
        "ENM01",
        "TLM01",
        "WHM01",
        "PRM01",
        "GSS01",
        "DSS01",
        "JSS01"
      )
  )
```

# Open ET

```{r}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)


download_openet_et <- function(
  lon,
  lat,
  start_date = "2020-01-01",
  end_date = "2020-12-31",
  interval = "daily",
  model = "Ensemble",
  variable = "ET",
  cache_dir = here::here("Data", ".cache"),
  refresh = FALSE
) {
  dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  cache_name <- sprintf(
    "openet_%0.8f_%0.8f_%s_%s_%s_%s_%s.rds",
    lon,
    lat,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    interval,
    model,
    variable
  ) |>
    gsub(
      pattern = "[^A-Za-z0-9._-]",
      replacement = "_",
      x = _
    )

  cache_file <- file.path(cache_dir, cache_name)

  # Return the cached result unless a fresh download is requested
  if (file.exists(cache_file) && !refresh) {
    return(readRDS(cache_file))
  }

  url <- "https://openet-api.org/raster/timeseries/point"

  body <- list(
    date_range = list(start_date, end_date),
    interval = interval,
    geometry = list(lon, lat),
    model = model,
    variable = variable,
    reference_et = "gridMET",
    units = "mm",
    file_format = "JSON"
  )

  response <- httr2::request(url) |>
    httr2::req_method("POST") |>
    httr2::req_headers(
      Authorization = Sys.getenv("OPENET_API_KEY"),
      Accept = "application/json",
      `Content-Type` = "application/json"
    ) |>
    httr2::req_body_json(body) |>
    httr2::req_error(is_error = \(resp) FALSE) |>
    httr2::req_perform()

  if (httr2::resp_status(response) >= 400) {
    error_details <- tryCatch(
      httr2::resp_body_json(response)$detail,
      error = function(e) httr2::resp_body_string(response)
    )

    stop(sprintf(
      "OpenET API request failed [%d]: %s",
      httr2::resp_status(response),
      error_details
    ))
  }

  result <- httr2::resp_body_json(response)

  et_data <- tibble::tibble(
    Date = as.Date(vapply(result, `[[`, character(1), "time")),
    ET_mm = as.numeric(vapply(result, `[[`, numeric(1), "et"))
  )

  saveRDS(et_data, cache_file)

  et_data
}


start_date <- "2021-01-01"
end_date <- "2025-01-01"

open_et <- allSites |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    et_data = purrr::pmap(
      list(lon, lat),
      \(lon, lat) {
        tryCatch(
          download_openet_et(
            lon = lon,
            lat = lat,
            start_date = start_date,
            end_date = end_date,
            interval = "daily"
          ),
          error = function(e) {
            warning(
              sprintf(
                "Download failed for %s, %s: %s",
                lon,
                lat,
                e$message
              )
            )
            NULL
          }
        )
      }
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(siteId, watershed, et_data) |>
  tidyr::unnest(et_data)
```

```{r}

et_all |>
```

```{r}
modisET <- read_csv(here("Data/ET/MODIS_ET.csv")) |>
  select(siteId = ID, Date, ET_1d = MOD16A2GF_061_ET_500m) |>
  left_join(allSites |> st_drop_geometry() |> select(siteId, watershed)) |>
  select(Site = watershed, Date, ET_1d)

modisET_daily <- modisET |>
  group_by(Site) |>
  # Fill in daily date sequence per Site
  complete(Date = seq(min(Date), max(Date), by = "day")) |>
  arrange(Site, Date) |>
  # Carry forward Site name (since complete() introduces NAs)
  fill(Site, .direction = "downup") |>
  group_split() |>
  map_dfr(\(df) {
    df$ET_1d <- approx(x = df$Date, y = df$ET_1d, xout = df$Date)$y
    df
  })

modisET_daily <- modisET_daily |>
  arrange(Site, Date) |>
  group_by(Site) |>
  mutate(
    ET_7d = slide_dbl(ET_1d, mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE),
    ET_14d = slide_dbl(ET_1d, mean, .before = 13, .complete = TRUE),
    ET_30d = slide_dbl(ET_1d, mean, .before = 29, .complete = TRUE),
    ET_60d = slide_dbl(ET_1d, mean, .before = 59, .complete = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  write_csv(here("Data/ET/MODIS_Daily_ET.csv"))

modisET_daily |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = ET_1d)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "MODIS ET",
    x = "Date",
    y = "ET (mm/day)"
  ) +
  theme_few()
```

```{r}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)


if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("OPENET_API_KEY"))) {
  stop("Set the OPENET_API_KEY environment variable first.")
}

all_sheds <- read_sf(here("Data/all_sheds.geojson"))

# Validate and standardize the geometry
all_sheds <- all_sheds |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_make_valid()


# Check request-area limits
area_check <- tibble(
  watershed = all_sheds$watershed,
  area_acres = as.numeric(
    units::set_units(
      st_area(st_transform(all_sheds, 5070)),
      "acre"
    )
  )
)

print(area_check)

if (any(area_check$area_acres > 50000)) {
  warning(
    "At least one watershed exceeds the standard 50,000-acre ",
    "OpenET per-request area limit. Check your account tier."
  )
}
```

```{r}
geojson_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".geojson")

st_write(
  all_sheds |> select(watershed),
  geojson_file,
  driver = "GeoJSON",
  quiet = TRUE
)

geojson <- read_json(geojson_file, simplifyVector = FALSE)
unlink(geojson_file)

# Give each request a complete, one-feature GeoJSON FeatureCollection
watershed_geojson <- map(
  geojson$features,
  \(feature) {
    list(
      type = "FeatureCollection",
      features = list(feature)
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
get_openet_et <- function(
  i,
  year,
  cache_dir = here::here("Data", ".cache"),
  refresh = FALSE
) {
  watershed_id <- all_sheds$watershed[[i]]

  dir.create(
    cache_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  safe_watershed_id <- gsub(
    "[^A-Za-z0-9._-]",
    "_",
    as.character(watershed_id)
  )

  cache_file <- file.path(
    cache_dir,
    sprintf(
      "openet_polygon_%s_%d.rds",
      safe_watershed_id,
      year
    )
  )

  # Return the saved result when it is already available
  if (file.exists(cache_file) && !refresh) {
    return(readRDS(cache_file))
  }

  request_body <- list(
    date_range = c(
      sprintf("%d-01-01", year),
      sprintf("%d-12-31", year)
    ),
    interval = "daily",
    overpass = FALSE,
    geojson = watershed_geojson[[i]],
    model = "Ensemble",
    variable = "ET",
    reference_et = "gridMET",
    reducer = "mean",
    version = 2.1,
    units = "mm",
    file_format = "JSON"
  )

  response <- httr2::request(
    "https://openet-api.org/raster/timeseries/polygon"
  ) |>
    httr2::req_headers(
      Authorization = Sys.getenv("OPENET_API_KEY"),
      Accept = "application/json"
    ) |>
    httr2::req_body_json(request_body) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(seconds = 600) |>
    httr2::req_throttle(
      capacity = 1,
      fill_time_s = 3.1,
      realm = "openet-api"
    ) |>
    httr2::req_retry(
      max_tries = 5,
      is_transient = \(resp) {
        status <- httr2::resp_status(resp)

        status %in%
          c(429, 503) ||
          (status == 400 &&
            stringr::str_detect(
              httr2::resp_body_string(resp),
              stringr::fixed("Invalid geometry")
            ))
      },
      backoff = \(failed_attempts) {
        delay_cap <- min(
          300,
          15 * 2^(failed_attempts - 1)
        )

        stats::runif(
          n = 1,
          min = 0,
          max = delay_cap
        )
      }
    ) |>
    httr2::req_error(
      body = \(resp) {
        paste0(
          "OpenET response: ",
          httr2::resp_body_string(resp)
        )
      }
    ) |>
    httr2::req_perform()

  result <- httr2::resp_body_json(
    response,
    simplifyVector = TRUE
  )

  if (
    is.list(result) &&
      !is.data.frame(result) &&
      "data" %in% names(result)
  ) {
    result <- result$data
  }

  result <- tibble::as_tibble(result)
  names(result) <- tolower(names(result))

  if (!all(c("time", "et") %in% names(result))) {
    stop(
      "Unexpected OpenET response for ",
      watershed_id,
      " in ",
      year,
      ". Columns returned: ",
      paste(names(result), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  et_data <- result |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      watershed = watershed_id,
      date = as.Date(time),
      et_mm = as.numeric(et)
    )

  saveRDS(et_data, cache_file)

  et_data
}
```


```{r}
jobs <- tidyr::crossing(
  watershed_index = seq_len(nrow(all_sheds)),
  year = 2021:2025
)

results <- vector("list", nrow(jobs))

for (j in 2:nrow(jobs)) {
  i <- jobs$watershed_index[[j]]
  year <- jobs$year[[j]]

  cli::cli_alert_info(
    "{.strong [{j}/{nrow(jobs)}]} {all_sheds$watershed[[i]]}, {year}"
  )

  Sys.sleep(5)
  results[[j]] <- get_openet_et(i, year)
}
```


```{r}

openet_et <- purrr::list_rbind(results) |>
  arrange(watershed, date)


openet_et |>

```



```{r}
et_compare <- modisET_daily |>
  transmute(
    site = Site,
    date = Date,
    modis_et_mm = modisET
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    openet_et |>
      transmute(
        site = watershed,
        date = date,
        openet_et_mm = et_mm
      ),
    by = c("site", "date")
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(modis_et_mm),
    is.finite(openet_et_mm)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    difference_mm = openet_et_mm - modis_et_mm
  )

ggplot(
  et_compare,
  aes(x = modis_et_mm, y = openet_et_mm)
) +
  geom_hex() +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    color = "red"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~site) +
  labs(
    x = "MODIS ET (mm/day)",
    y = "OpenET ET (mm/day)",
    fill = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}

r2_labels <- et_compare |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    r_squared = summary(
      lm(openet_et_mm ~ modis_et_mm)
    )$r.squared,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    label = sprintf("R² = %.3f", r_squared)
  )

ggplot(
  et_compare,
  aes(x = modis_et_mm, y = openet_et_mm)
) +
  geom_hex() +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    color = "blue"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = r2_labels,
    aes(
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = -0.2,
    vjust = 1.3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~site) +
  labs(
    x = "MODIS ET (mm/day)",
    y = "OpenET ET (mm/day)",
    fill = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
